stock.sub: Brick and timber lowsets on full-sized blocks, with growing knock-down-rebuild activity

green_space.sub: Bulimba Creek bikeway, a slice of Minnippi Parklands and two fenced dog parks

stations.name: Closest stations are Cannon Hill and Coorparoo

buses.note: Routes 200 (Queen St), 204 (Fortitude Valley) and 222 (Roma St) confirmed at the Old Cleveland Rd Carina stops (TransLink stop 002556, 15 Aug 2026).

driving.motorway_access: M3 corridor for southern travel. Story Bridge for the CBD.
driving.approx_cbd_minutes_offpeak_note: Approximately 13 to 17 minutes to Brisbane CBD off-peak.

primary_state.name: Mayfield State School (in-suburb; Carina SS is physically in Carindale)

parks: Two fenced dog off-leash areas (Joe Bradfield Park, Meadowlands Rd)
Whites Hill Reserve nearby (Camp Hill/Carina Heights)
lifestyle.shops_dining_note: The Clem Jones Centre and Carina Leagues Club anchor the community. Westfield Carindale is a short drive for big-format retail and dining. Camp Hill Marketplace handles village dining within a 5 to 10 minute drive.

pockets.name: Whites Hill catchment streets
pockets.character: Streets commonly cited as Whites Hill State College catchment. Premium family pocket, verify per address.

pockets.name: Zahel and Fursden sporting belt
pockets.character: The streets around the Clem Jones Centre and AC Carina's Fursden Road ground. Community-sport heart of the suburb.

pockets.name: Old Cleveland Road corridor
pockets.character: Closer to the arterial and the bus spine, with the heritage tram tracks in the median.

pockets.name: Lunga Street heritage pocket
pockets.character: The suburb's oldest subdivision, anchored by 1892 Flint's Cottage.

buyer_profile.note: Buyers targeting the Whites Hill catchment and the family-suburb feel.
Buyers who searched Camp Hill or Coorparoo and land here with a full block for the same money.
Post-war stock attracts buyers looking for well-located projects with room to add value.
